moat.title: Strengths (RHP)
moat.body:
- Two-segment presence spanning real estate and textile yarn, which management frames as serving two essential human needs (housing and clothing)
- Direct customer relationships, dealer networks and B2B sales channels in the textile yarn segment, with emphasis on product quality and timely delivery
- Board skill set covering production, marketing, operations, finance and real estate, per the Corporate Governance skills matrix
- Harmonious and cordial industrial relations reported across the employee base

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- MD&A Risks and Concerns names geopolitical and tariff-related risks, which management says may indirectly impact the Company's customers and their supply chains.
- MD&A lists currency volatility and raw material price fluctuations as key concerns; the Board's Report adds that fluctuations in raw material prices, power and fuel costs and availability of skilled labour impact textile yarn manufacturing operations.
- MD&A flags interest rate changes and credit availability in the real estate sector; the Board's Report adds that variations in interest rates and inflation affect consumer demand and project financing. Real estate growth is described as closely tied to income levels and access to affordable credit.
- The Board's Report cites delays in approvals, permissions, environmental clearances and compliance requirements relating to real estate projects as a factor beyond management's control that may influence future performance - material given the Company's core activity is a single villa project at Khandala.
- Changes in RERA regulations, land acquisition policies, development control regulations and other statutory compliances, plus changes in government policies, regulations and taxation applicable to the real estate and textile industries, are explicitly listed as constraints on future performance.
- MD&A Threats states Indian textile companies face stiff competition from neighbouring countries with higher output and aggressive pricing, affecting export competitiveness; the Board's Report adds volatility in domestic and international demand, export-import policies and foreign exchange fluctuations affecting the textile business.
- MD&A Threats notes investor interest is currently skewed toward equity markets due to better returns, while property valuations remain high and rental yields low.
- The Board's Report lists supply chain disruptions and changes in government incentives, subsidies or industry support schemes among external factors that may influence future performance.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Complete the villa development at the Khandala real estate project site, which management describes as substantially progressed and at the verge of completion, and expects to contribute positively to future operations.
- Continue operating both businesses - real estate development and the existing textile yarn manufacturing business - rather than exiting either.
- Capitalise on post-RERA real estate momentum while maintaining long-standing business values and industry relationships.
- Strengthen real estate market presence through digital marketing, channel partner networks, project branding, …
